rationale: The paper 'A Census of Near-UV M-dwarf Flares Using Archival GALEX Data and the gPHOTON2 Pipeline' provides substantive new evidence on the rate of energetic flares by analyzing a large dataset of M-dwarf flares, contributing to the understanding of their occurrence rates.
